Keep the beige wooden king head and complete cross, two blue eyes, silver monocle and chain, purple tailcoat with pale piping and lilac tails, gray-lilac diamond vest, black tie and blue flower ornament. Full silhouette centered with ample transparent margins around cross, gloves and base. Crisp dark contours and restrained flat cel shading. Native transparent RGBA, clean isolated cartoon artwork, no other character, objects, scenery, letters, shadow, glow or framing.
